title: Top
text: I appreciated all the boat and helicopter rides, it was super cool, pleasant company. I indicated it to the people who are looking to do something different. Thank you
author: Holivan_V

title: Worth the experience
text: The helicopter flight was great with panoramic views of the coastline and beyond. We captured the Sagrada Familia from a birds eye view. Highly recommend looking at adding other flight options as they range from 7 minutes up to 40 minutes when your at meeting point.
author: josef971

title: A day in Barcelona
text: The helicopter ride was amazing!! The staff were very professional and informative. And the views of all of Barcelona was breathtaking Then the cruise was exceptional!! The captain was so accommodating! We had drinks and snacks. The boat was clean and in great condition!  We definitely recommend both of these activities. And, we will do it again!!!
author: Kelly V

title: Great day!
text: Helicopter ride was short but fun and we were able to see a good part of the city. Boat ride was great Manuel was our captain on the boat he was great with getting us drink’s whenever we needed and offered to take photos for us. Was great with giving restaurant recommendations after the tour has ended. Was very knowledgeable about other boats and buildings we saw throughout the ride.
author: Elizabeth_B

title: Helicopter Flight
text: Thanks for Helicopter Flight experience, Really I enjoy it and the employees support us before the trip 👍🏽
author: Fahhad_A

title: Fabulous!
text:
The "sailing" experience was great, loved the wine and cheese and a friendly skipper with an option to swim on a tow rope. Only thing was that it wasn't actually a sail, only a drive in a sailboat. But we didn't mind, the view of Barcelona was fabulous and we had a great time. 

Also absolutely loved the helicopter ride. I only wish it was longer, we would have been happy to pay for even just a bit more time. 

Overall, we had a really great time and it was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona!
author: catthetraveljunkie

title: Helicopter view was...
text: Helicopter view was wonderful. The sailboat experience was priceless. So much fun all around. David was a great guide on the boat.
author: Maria_E

title: Something to remember, maybe even once in a lifetime
text:
It was a memorable day, maybe once in a lifetime.

We were supposed to go sailing at 12:00 but the sea was too agitated and the captains decided it was too risky or unpleasant for us to proceed, so they were kind to reschedule us for the sunset at 19:00, as we had a flight next day in the morning. Also, we were wellcomed on a catamaran with snacks, drinks and... live guitar chords. It was such a great experience! They even invited our little boy upstairs, by the captain and took him pictures. author: oanap

title: Sailing trip was amazing!
text: The helicopter flight was unique and fun, but what really stood out was the sailing trip. We had such an amazing time and were truly impressed with the seamanship of our captain! We did a lot of fun things in Barcelona but this was over the top fun. Definitely do it if you have the chance.
author: Kira_A

title: Nice trip!
text: Fantastic! The boat crew was excellent and looked after us well. Plenty of Carva flowed and nibbles. The helicopter was great. All very slick and professional.
author: Simon_N
